description: Generate a publication-style schematic of the glucarate/galactarate to 2-oxoglutarate module, showing the convergent entry, shared intermediate, and the branch point vs the E. coli aldolytic fate
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 8.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 13); ax.set_ylim(0, 9); ax.axis('off')

def box(x, y, w, h, text, fc, ec='black', fs=9, fw='normal'):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.06,rounding_size=0.12",
                       fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=1.4)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    ax.text(x+w/2, y+h/2, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw, wrap=True)

def arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, label='', color='black', lw=2.0, ls='-', off=0.15):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2), arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=18,
                        color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls, shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2)
    ax.add_patch(a)
    if label:
        ax.text((x1+x2)/2+off, (y1+y2)/2, label, ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=8, color=color, style='italic')

met = '#DCE6F1'; enz1='#FDE9D9'; enz2='#E2EFDA'; branch='#F8CBAD'; term='#FFF2CC'

# Substrates
box(0.3, 7.4, 2.4, 1.0, "D-glucarate", met, fs=11, fw='bold')
box(0.3, 5.4, 2.4, 1.0, "galactarate\n(mucate)", met, fs=11, fw='bold')

# Entry enzymes (arrows)
arrow(2.7, 7.9, 5.0, 7.0, "GudD / GlucD\nglucarate dehydratase\n(enolase superfamily, Mg2+)\nEC 4.2.1.40", '#C55A11')
arrow(2.7, 5.9, 5.0, 6.6, "GarD & convergent paralogues\ngalactarate dehydratase\n(GarD: novel fold)\nEC 4.2.1.42", '#548235', off=0.15)

# Shared intermediate
box(5.0, 6.2, 3.1, 1.2,
    "5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucarate\n(= 5-keto-4-deoxy-glucarate, KDG\n= 2-keto-3-deoxy-hexarate)", met, fs=8.5, fw='bold', ec='navy')

# Branch point label
ax.text(6.55, 5.75, "BRANCH POINT (mutually exclusive fates)", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8.5, color='firebrick', fontweight='bold')

# ---- Route A: to 2-oxoglutarate (module of interest) ----
arrow(8.1, 6.9, 9.4, 6.9, '', '#7030A0')
box(9.4, 6.3, 3.3, 1.2,
    "2,5-dioxopentanoate\n(alpha-ketoglutarate semialdehyde,\nalpha-KGSA)", term, fs=8.5, fw='bold')
ax.text(8.75, 7.25, "KDG dehydratase\n(decarboxylating)\nEC 4.2.1.41\n- CO2, - H2O",
        ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.6, color='#7030A0', style='italic')

arrow(11.05, 6.3, 11.05, 4.6, '', '#7030A0')
ax.text(11.2, 5.45, "KGSADH / 2,5-dioxovalerate\ndehydrogenase  EC 1.2.1.26\n+ NAD(P)+  -> NAD(P)H", ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.6, color='#7030A0', style='italic')
box(9.4, 3.4, 3.3, 1.1, "2-OXOGLUTARATE\n(2-oxoglutarate / alpha-KG)", '#C6E0B4', fs=10, fw='bold', ec='darkgreen')
ax.text(11.05, 2.9, "-> TCA cycle / N assimilation\n(outside core boundary)", ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color='gray')

ax.text(11.05, 8.05, "ROUTE A  =  MODULE OF INTEREST\n(oxidative-uronate terminal steps;\nAgrobacterium, Azospirillum, Pseudomonas, fungi)",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#7030A0', fontweight='bold')

# ---- Route B: E. coli aldolytic fate ----
arrow(6.55, 6.2, 6.55, 4.6, '', '#BF9000')
ax.text(6.7, 5.4, "GarL\n5-keto-4-deoxy-glucarate\naldolase (retro-aldol)", ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.6, color='#BF9000', style='italic')
box(4.6, 3.4, 3.9, 1.1, "tartronate semialdehyde  +  pyruvate", branch, fs=8.5)
arrow(6.55, 3.4, 6.55, 2.5, 'GarR / GarK', '#BF9000', off=0.15)
box(4.6, 1.5, 3.9, 1.0, "glycerate -> 2-phosphoglycerate", branch, fs=8.5)
ax.text(6.55, 0.9, "ROUTE B  =  canonical E. coli / Salmonella\n(does NOT yield 2-oxoglutarate)",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#BF9000', fontweight='bold')

# Upstream (outside boundary)
box(0.3, 3.4, 2.4, 1.0, "uronates\n(glucuronate/\ngalacturonate)", '#EDEDED', fs=8)
arrow(1.5, 4.4, 1.5, 5.4, 'Udh, Gci\n(upstream,\noutside core)', 'gray', lw=1.5, ls='--', off=0.12)

ax.text(6.5, 8.75, "Bacterial glucarate/galactarate catabolism to 2-oxoglutarate: a reusable module",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# Legend
handles = [mpatches.Patch(fc=met, ec='k', label='metabolite'),
           mpatches.Patch(fc=term, ec='k', label='shared 2-oxo intermediate / product'),
           mpatches.Patch(fc=branch, ec='k', label='alternative (aldolytic) fate'),
           mpatches.Patch(fc='#EDEDED', ec='k', label='outside core boundary')]
ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower left', fontsize=7.5, frameon=True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('pathway_schematic.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Schematic saved. Figure summarizes convergent entry, shared intermediate, and the mutually exclusive Route A (to 2-oxoglutarate) vs Route B (E. coli aldolytic).")
